415	            )

425	def _override_scheme_with_user_specify(
426	    scheme: Union[str, dict, QuantizationScheme], user_scheme_overrides: dict[str, Any], return_str=True
427	) -> Union[str, QuantizationScheme]:
428	    """
429	    Updates a base quantization scheme with user-provided overrides.
430	    Handles GGUF formatting and synchronizes weight/activation parameters.
431	    """
432	    # 1. GGUF special handling: map data_type suffix to GGUF scheme names
433	    dt_override = user_scheme_overrides.get("data_type", "")
434	    if (
435	        isinstance(scheme, QuantizationScheme) or (isinstance(scheme, str) and not scheme.startswith("gguf"))
436	    ) and dt_override.endswith("_dq"):
437	        if "bits" not in user_scheme_overrides:
438	            raise KeyError(f"Must specify 'bits' when using data_type={dt_override}")
439	
440	        bits = user_scheme_overrides["bits"]
441	        suffix = "k" if bits == 6 else "k_s"
442	        scheme = f"gguf:q{bits}_{suffix}"
443	
444	    # 2. Convert input scheme to a dictionary for processing
445	    if isinstance(scheme, QuantizationScheme):
446	        scheme_dict = asdict(scheme)
447	    elif isinstance(scheme, str):
448	        normalized_name = scheme.strip("'\" ").upper()
449	        if normalized_name.startswith("GGUF") and len(user_scheme_overrides) > 0:
450	            logger.warning_once(
451	                "When using GGUF scheme, user-specified overrides will be ignored to ensure format compatibility."
452	            )
453	            user_scheme_overrides = {}
454	        # If no overrides exist, return the normalized string immediately
455	        if not user_scheme_overrides and return_str:
456	            return normalized_name
457	        scheme_dict = asdict(preset_name_to_scheme(normalized_name))
458	    else:
459	        scheme_dict = scheme.copy()
460	
461	    # 3. Apply overrides and define default behaviors
462	    scheme_dict.update(user_scheme_overrides)
463	
464	    if scheme_dict.get("act_dynamic") is None:
465	        scheme_dict["act_dynamic"] = True
466	
467	    # 4. Reconcile weight settings (bits vs data_type)
468	    _reconcile_bits_and_dtype(scheme_dict)
469	
470	    # 5. Fallback logic: Inherit activation settings from weight settings
471	    scheme_dict["act_group_size"] = (
472	        scheme_dict.get("act_group_size")
473	        if scheme_dict.get("act_group_size") is not None
474	        else scheme_dict.get("group_size")
475	    )
476	    scheme_dict["act_bits"] = scheme_dict.get("act_bits") or 16
477	    scheme_dict["act_sym"] = (
478	        scheme_dict.get("act_sym") if scheme_dict.get("act_sym") is not None else scheme_dict.get("sym")
479	    )
480	
481	    # 6. Activation data_type logic
482	    if scheme_dict.get("act_data_type") is None:
483	        is_supported = scheme_dict["data_type"] in SUPPORTED_DTYPES
484	        if is_supported and scheme_dict["act_bits"] < 16:
485	            scheme_dict["act_data_type"] = scheme_dict["data_type"]
486	            logger.info(f"Activation adopting weight data_type: {scheme_dict['data_type']}")
487	        else:
488	            scheme_dict["act_data_type"] = "float"
489	
490	    # 7. Reconcile activation settings
491	    _reconcile_bits_and_dtype(scheme_dict, prefix="act_")
492

3	This file provides guidance to ANY AGENTS when working with code in this repository.

5	## Project
6	
7	AutoRound — post-training quantization for LLMs/VLMs using sign-gradient descent. Publishes as `auto-round` (GPU/CPU) and `auto-round-hpu` (Intel Gaudi).
8	
9	## Build & Install
10	
11	```bash
12	# From source (GPU/CPU) — --no-build-isolation is required when PyTorch is already installed

22	```
23	
24	## Testing
25	
26	Tests are split into three tiers under `test/`: `unit/` (fast, runs in PR CI),
27	`integration/` (third-party frameworks, runs nightly), and `e2e/` (full models /
28	real inference engines, runs weekly). Each tier is further split by hardware
29	(`test_cpu/`, `test_cuda/`, `test_hpu/`, `test_xpu/`, `test_ark/`, `test_mlx/`).
